verdict.rationale: The evidence shows RevenueCat sends webhook notifications when events happen. That is an outbound event feed a developer can build automation on, not a product feature for defining rules that trigger actions. Nothing in the pack documents user-defined conditions, triggers or automated actions, and a community feature request asks for timed hooks such as trial-expiry reminders, suggesting this kind of automation is not built in.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
